content: {"like":["Gatchaman II followed the original series closely, which the reviewer didn’t mind","The new Gatchaman Fighter series took a whole new route, appreciated by the reviewer","The modular Gatchaspartan, made up of the five team vehicles, was liked","The focus on Ken instead of Joe the Condor was acceptable to the reviewer","The overall quality of the late 70’s/early 80’s anime was considered awesome and worth the price"],"dislike":["The disposable second‑in‑command officers in the first two series were disliked","Egobossler’s sub‑commanders were seen as a negative change compared to the first two series","Egobossler’s portrayal as a WW II‑style dictator and the Nazi salute were criticized","Ken’s Hypershoot made him essentially invincible, making other team members feel like bystanders","The season’s subtitles and lack of HD release were noted as drawbacks","The absence of dubbed versions and HD releases for the series was a disappointment"]}
